dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.ordersBody: Receive and manage orders in real time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.addressBody: Customers open your menu at this address. Your printed QR codes keep working even if it changes later.
settings.addressFixed: Changing the café address is not available yet — contact us if you need it.
settings.detailsBody: Shown on your menu. The currency and time zone are used for prices and orders.
settings.contactBody: How customers reach your café: phone and email, plus your Facebook and Instagram pages.
settings.colourBody: Your menu's colours are generated from this colour.

profile.emailPending: Confirmed. Now open the link we sent to your other address to finish the change.
profile.languageBody: The language of your dashboard and of the emails Serbi sends you.
profile.emailBody: Changing it needs a confirmation: we email a link to the new address (and to your current one). The change happens once confirmed.
profile.waitingFor: Waiting for confirmation of {email}. Open the link we emailed.
profile.passwordBody: Enter your current password, then the new one. Other devices are signed out.
profile.passwordRules: At least 10 characters with an upper-case letter, a digit and a symbol.

languagesTab.offeredBody: Customers can read your menu and website in these languages. Texts you haven't translated yet show in your main language.
languagesTab.mainHint: Main language — change it in the Café tab
languagesTab.requestBody: Serbi can add languages like Spanish, Italian or German to your café. Send a request — we'll notify you when it's reviewed.
languagesTab.whyHint: e.g. Many Italian tourists visit us in summer
languagesTab.allRequested: All supported languages are available or requested.

menu.title: Menu
menu.summary: {categories} categories · {items} items. Changes show to customers within a minute.
menu.emptyDescription: Your categories and items, with prices and photos.
menu.emptyBody: Start from a ready-made café menu (Coffee, Tea, Pastries, Cold drinks — in your menu language) and edit it, or start empty. Items show to customers once they have a price.
menu.notPriced: {count, plural, one {# item has no price yet — customers don't see it until you set one.} other {# items have no price yet — customers don't see them until you set one.}}
menu.deleteCategoryBody: Only empty categories can be deleted. Move or delete its items first.
menu.deleteItemBody: It disappears from your menu. This can't be undone.
menu.translationNote: {language} translation. Empty fields show the {main} text.
menu.name: Name
menu.priceHint: Leave empty to keep it hidden for now
menu.availableCheck: Available — uncheck when it's sold out
menu.featuredCheck: Featured — shown on your website's "Signature specialties"

tables.title: Tables & QR
tables.description: Your areas and tables, and the QR codes customers scan to open your menu.
tables.menuQrBody: For your counter, window, flyers or takeaway bags. It opens your menu without a table. Each table below has its own code, so orders know where to go.
tables.menuQrStats: {scans} scans in the last 30 days · code {code}
tables.startBody: An area is a room or zone of your café — e.g. Inside or Terrace. Then add its tables.
tables.areaSummary: {width} × {depth} m · {tables, plural, one {# table} other {# tables}} · {seats, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}
tables.help3d: Drag to turn around · scroll or pinch to zoom · click a table for its QR code. Arrange tables in the Floor plan.
tables.pickBody: Click a table in the 3D view to see its QR code.
tables.noTablesBody: Add the tables of this area. Each gets its own QR code to print.
tables.name: Name
tables.sizeHint: Approximate size — used for the floor plan.
tables.deleteTableBody: Its printed QR code will stop working. This can't be undone.
tables.deleteAreaBody: Only empty areas can be deleted.
tables.newCodeBody: Use this if a QR sticker was copied or damaged. The old code will still open your menu, but no longer identifies the table — print and replace it.
tables.inUse: In use — its QR code opens the menu with this table

floor.help: Drag tables to place them. Select one to rotate it — or use the arrow keys and R.
floor.tableLabel: {label}, {seats} seats, at {x} by {y} metres, rotated {rotation} degrees
floor.footer: {name}: {width} × {depth} m · grid 50 cm. Double-click a table (or press Enter) to edit it.
